name: Operation Sindoor (2025)
description: Integrated missile and air strikes on 9 terror sites across Pakistan and Pakistan-Occupied Kashmir. Largest aerial engagement between India and Pakistan in 50+ years. Culmination of punitive deterrence doctrine.

trigger_event.event: Pahalgam massacre — TRF gunmen kill 26 tourists at Baisaran meadow; deadliest civilian attack since 26/11

operation_details.targets: 9 sites: 4 Pakistan (Bahawalpur, Muridke, Sialkot, Markaz-e-Taiba), 5 PoK (Kotli, Gulpur, etc.)
operation_details.platforms: Rafale (Scalp missiles), Su-30MKI (BrahMos), Mirage 2000, Heron drones, submarine-launched missiles
operation_details.claim: 100+ terrorists killed; JeM/LeT/Hizbul command centers destroyed

pakistani_response.operation_bunyan_un_marsoos: 'Wall of Lead' — retaliatory strikes on Indian airbases (ambala, sirsa, pathankot, etc.)
pakistani_response.escalation: Drone/missile exchanges; 72-hour conflict; US-brokered ceasefire May 10
pakistani_response.casualties: Limited Indian damage; Pakistani claims disputed

strategic_significance.doctrine_maturity: Full-spectrum retaliation: air, missile, submarine, special forces integration
strategic_significance.target_depth: Struck Pakistan proper (not just PoK) — Bahawalpur (JeM HQ), Muridke (LeT)
strategic_significance.international: US mediation; ceasefire within 72 hours; demonstrated escalation control

film_relevance.epilogue: Red Fort bombing (Nov 2025) shows war continues — Part 5 setup
